While it seems versatile, this talisman is actually rarely used in place of the four standard elemental talismans, most likely because they can be made into their related tiaras, which this talisman cannot. It has been superseded in most cases by the wicked hood, omni-talisman and omni-tiara.
Unlike regular talismans, it cannot be used to enter the rune temples with the left-click "Enter" function on the ruins; the elemental talisman must be used on the ruins to gain entry.
▸ Combination runes
It cannot be used as the talisman ingredient required for crafting combination runes.
▸ Locate function
The elemental talisman functions as an air talisman with its locate function, leading the user to the air altar. The exception is when the player is already inside the water/earth/fire altar, in which case the location function returns "You are standing in the water/earth/fire temple."
Using the elemental talisman on the map in the Runecrafting Guild however, would reveal all four elemental altars at once.
▸ Wicked hood
Using this talisman on a wicked hood unlocks all access to the runecrafting altars of all elemental runes with the hood.

Elemental talismans can be obtained as drops from the monsters of The Abyss. Although it is not common, it is fairly easy to obtain due to their low life points. The easiest way to obtain this drop is to use the fairy ring () to go to the Abyssal Area. After a while in the abyss, the monsters become tolerant of you.
You may also purchase one on the Grand Exchange, which may be an alternative method instead of killing abyssal creatures yourself.

The following locations are not checked by the wealth evaluator:
• Player-owned house, for example costume room contents
• Tool leprechauns
• Managing Miscellania cash or resources
• Diango's Item Retrieval
• Resource plot, e.g. crops, compost bins, matured ale in vats
• Containers - the value does not reflect the contents:
• Rune essence pouches (any pure essence contained is not counted)
• Resource crates 
• Gem bag (25,000 - gems not counted)
• Ore box (box itself is counted, but any ores contained are not counted)
• Bound items in Dungeoneering
• Eluned's crystal store
• Elite dungeon chest
• Sophanem slayer dungeon chest
• Hidey-holes, used to store items required in emote clues during Treasure Trails
• Ritual chest
• Flower basket contents
• Chests that store boss loot, such as Amascut, the Devourer's Treasure
